handle.representation: a zero-sized Copy struct with a private constructor (Appendix C.1)
handle.ownership: carries no state, so a copy is the capability itself; a future that holds one owns it and may be detached
handle.created_by: Host.capabilities(), called once by main (11.6); every other handle of this type is derived from that one

ownership.receiver: the handle by value (a Copy handle: copied, never consumed)
ownership.program: a read loan for the call, not retained
ownership.arguments: a read loan of the list for the call, not retained

run.allocation: none on success; the failure value with its `program` field when refused
run.cancellation: not a cancellation point: the call waits for the program to finish and holds its thread meanwhile (the `block` effect); async code runs it as blocking-pool work, which observes cancellation only at checkpoint() (12.4), while the cooperative tasks run on

waiting.states: the blocking work runs to completion on the blocking pool; the cooperative task runs after it and the scope joins both

violation.clause: starts no process; every program except true and false is refused
